checks: Separate fully test-time, source-free DA, prepared self-supervision and source/target joint training.
Tent v1 p3 explicitly mentions compatible probabilistic regressors; no categorical claim that entropy cannot concern any regression model.
A deterministic scalar alone is not a supplied predictive distribution; extra uncertainty assumptions/preparation must be justified.
Calibration evidence is adjacent classification evidence, not a direct proof about scalar-regression adaptation.
A valid different proposal/gap is acceptable; source SSA method and outcomes are not a gold answer.
Hypotheses should cover core proposal claims and conditions; no reward for weak irrelevant claims or ungrounded universal guarantees.
Do not require recovering the target method, PCA/subspace construction, regression-head weighting, or any particular proposal.

The fixed report is a deliberately bounded developmental starting point, not a comprehensive literature review. Missing unprovided literature is a material-coverage limitation, not by itself a solver failure.
Model/tool execution budget is not evidence that a future experimental program has been measured to cost the same amount.

fixed_reference_scope.judging_boundary: Assess substantive difference against the supplied fixed report and supportable facts; do not penalize failure to discuss unprovided new R2 references or assume access to the target paper.

temporal_audit: Pinned arXiv v1 and known official repository creation metadata are recorded in research/benchmark/materials/pilot_v3/literature_v3/source_time_audit.json. Other earlier project/repository/report disclosure is not excluded; no complete historical or model-memory isolation is claimed.
